items:
"FantaSea", our luxury beach home is perfect for family reunions, a large family, or several families vacationing together.

This home has 5 bedrooms, including 4 master suites with king beds and private baths. One of the master suites can be used as an Au Pair/ Family Suite, equipped with a crib, an oversized chair that converts to twin a bed and a morning kitchen with refrigerator and microwave. There is also a bunkroom that sleeps 8, containing 4 full bunk beds, and 4 twin bunk beds. All bedrooms have flat panel TVs.

The 1st floor has a wet bar with ice maker and beverage cooler (convenient to the private pool), a media/recroom, the bunkroom, bathroom and 1 private master suite.

The 2nd floor has a private master suite, office, laundry room, powder room, an open living room, dining room and kitchen, 2 porches, one is screened, with amazing Lake and Gulf views.

The 3rd floor has 2 master suites (one of which could be used as a family suite), Workout Room, and a Gulfview porch great for quiet naps.

Our home provides privacy rarely found this close to the beach and all the other wonderful amenities Watersound has to offer.

reviews.text: Fantasea is a fantastic property for a family beach vacation. Tucked away off 30A, there is such a feeling of privacy and peace. This house has everything. Well constructed with gorgeous views, boardwalk through nature to the beach and a lovely pool. Our family’s favorite house by far for our annual summer vacation. They have thought of everything. We drove, but you could literally hop off a plane with a bathing suit and shorts and have all that you need.

reviews.author: William C.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: I thought I posted this shortly after our weekend stay, but this house is amazing in every way. We had an impromptu golf trip in February and were fortunate enough to find this amazing home available for the three nights that we were traveling to FL. The owner was incredibly accommodating, and again, the house was incredible. There was more than enough room for everyone in our group and the location was perfectly situated near the airport and golf courses that we played. I hope that we will be fortunate enough to stay there again, and I cannot emphasize how nice and accommodating this house was for a fairly large group of adults. Thank you and hope to stay there again.

reviews.label: Terrible
reviews.text: I so wanted to love this property. Location was beautiful but the house had so many issues. Pool tile literally falling off into the pool (large areas missing), main fridge was broken so there was a temp fridge sitting in the middle of the dining room (we were not told about this until after checkin) - so not 2 fridges, wine fridge didn't work, paddle boards had holes, toilets ran constantly, dishwashers were missing buttons and left sediment all over dishes, broken blinds, light bulbs burned out, downstairs showers leaked, tv in master didn't work - all tvs were super old and remotes were missing, outdoor furniture was nasty and cushions were worn out, mattresses were old and sunk, blender was broken, overall the house was not very clean - dirty baseboards and walls, toilets had mold in them, bathroom floors were not very clean, all the couches and chairs were worn out - the bottom cushions literally sank when you sat on them. I absolutely cannot recommend!
